Rialto

An arch that has held for five hundred years

The Rialto Bridge has held the two banks of Venice together with a single span since 1591. From that idea — structure becoming elegance — this frame was born: a wide front distributes the visual weight, the panthos profile softens the gaze. Wearable architecture, without rhetoric.
